question:

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN (l.XCL_022 > 8.0 AND p.XCL_059 = 'M') OR (l.XCL_022 > 6.5 AND p.XCL_059 = 'F') THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS within_normal_range
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.XCL_014 = p.XCL_058
WHERE p.XCL_058 = 57266
